title: Outcome After Arthroscopic Surgery in Patients Treated With PAO
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate outcome after arthroscopy if the hip in patients previous treated with periacetabular osteotomy
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* previous PAO and hip arthroscopy
* developmental dysplasia of the hip

Exclusion Criteria:

* calve legg perthes disease
* femoral osteotomy
study_population: Patients undergoing hip arthrocopy previous treated with periacetabular osteotomy
